edges.reason: Ramifi.transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the _from argument of transfer.
transferFrom enters the checkBots modifier, which performs an external call before any state update.
The checkBots modifier performs a low-level call to the external bot-protection contract.
The low-level call targets the mutable botProtection state variable.
uniPair is passed as an argument to the bot-protection call.
_from is forwarded to the bot-protection call.
_to is forwarded to the bot-protection call.
_value is forwarded to the bot-protection call.
The external bot-protection call executes before balanceOf and allowance are updated, permitting reentrant draining.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken in transferFrom.
_from indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
_to is credited in transferFrom.
_value drives all balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
transferFrom executes an unchecked allowance subtraction.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
msg.sender is the spender key of the allowance mapping being decremented.
transferFrom executes an unchecked sender balance subtraction.
_from indexes the balance being decremented.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes an unchecked recipient balance addition.
_to indexes the balance being incremented.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
balanceOf mapping is read before the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf mapping is read before the unchecked addition.
Ramifi.delegate invokes an arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata.
delegate gates execution on msg.sender being the owner.
The stored owner is compared against msg.sender before the delegatecall.
list performs an external router call while privileged balance writes are interleaved.
The router deadline is derived from block.timestamp, making execution miner-influenceable.
list depends on block.timestamp for its deadline computation.
list is restricted to the stored owner address.
msg.sender is checked against owner and credited 6% of totalSupply.
_numList is written directly into balanceOf[address(this)].
list performs an unconditional privileged balance overwrite.
_numList is passed as amountTokenDesired to addLiquidityETH.
totalSupply feeds a multiplication evaluated before division.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 for the owner allocation.
Loop index iterates the _tos recipient array.
Loop index iterates the _amounts array in lockstep.
The loop writes balanceOf for each recipient.
_tos entries are used as keys of the balanceOf mapping.
_amounts entries are assigned as balances.
The router pulls tokens back through transferFrom, re-entering the bot-checked token logic mid-execution.
The constructor derives and stores uniPair.
The constructor assigns the hardcoded Uniswap router.
owner is set from msg.sender at deployment.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
The constructor grants infinite allowances to the router and the Uniswap pair.
The constructor calls pairFor to compute the pair address.
_botProtection is stored by the BotProtected constructor.
_botProtection is forwarded from the Ramifi constructor to BotProtected.
approve performs an unrestricted allowance write.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance written by approve.
_spender is the spender key of the allowance written by approve.
approve mutates the allowance mapping.
ERC20.transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
ERC20.transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
ERC20.approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the botProtection state variable initialization.
Source address parameter is consumed solely by the bot check and unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is consumed solely by the bot check and recipient balance credit in transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
Target address parameter is used only as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter is used only as the delegatecall payload.
Liquidity amount parameter feeds the privileged balance overwrite and the router call in list.
Recipient array parameter is only iterated to assign balances in list.
Amount array parameter is only iterated to assign balances in list.
Success flag local is produced and required inside the checkBots modifier.
Return-data local is produced inside the checkBots modifier only.
Loop index local exists only inside the list recipient loop.
Pair address local is computed and returned by pairFor.
